[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: PR2 — report_payout_event batch backfill (cluster payouts: one lump, N single-tree PAYOUT events)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dapp_beta/pull/146
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1455
  
  Details:
  Shipped PR2 of plans/PAYOUT_FARM_PLOT_FILTER_PLAN.md (dapp_beta #146, sha 3b38bf1).
  
  Goal: let Gary back-record a cluster payout (e.g. R$500 lump for Paulo's 10 Fazenda Bom Sucesso trees) in one pass, so the trees flip from outstanding to paid.
  
  Load-bearing design finding (verified at source): the payout sink books exactly ONE unit of 'Cacao Tree - To Be Paid For' liability per event — fpeComputeLegs_ emits a single inv('main',-1,...) in every branch and fpeBookLedger_ discharges only the FIRST resolvable tree (tokenomics process_payout_event_telegram_logs.js). So a batch MUST fire N single-tree [PAYOUT EVENT]s each carrying total/N; a single multi-tree event would silently under-book N-1 trees.
  
  Changes:
  - payout-event-utils.js: new pure splitBatchAmount(total, N) -> {total, perTree, count, drift} (pt-BR aware, reports rounding drift).
  - report_payout_event.html: 'Backfill a cluster' toggle, checkbox tree list, Submit Batch Payout, per-tree success/fail summary; submitBatch loops N single-tree events sequentially, shares paidAt/bankRef/receiptUrl (one PIX reconciles to one statement line), re-renders to drop paid trees (no double-submit surface).
  - tests: +6 unit tests (splitBatchAmount, 125/125 pass); +2 Playwright tests (per-tree firing; mid-batch failure reported per-tree, never swallowed).
  
  Testing: all 10 unit files pass; batch spec 2 passed; full Playwright 46 passed (only pre-existing failures remain — FARM/PLOT confirmed failing on clean main too; 3 others unrelated).
  
  Gates: no production deploy, no payout fired. Beta only. PR3 (prod promote) remains the always-stop gate.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
